sections.title: Purpose of data processing
sections.content: Personal data collected through this website is processed for the following purposes: managing information and contact requests received through the web form, providing the professional services requested, sending communications related to contracted services, and complying with applicable legal obligations.

sections.title: Legal basis for processing
sections.content: The legal basis for processing your personal data is the consent given when submitting the contact form, the performance of a contract or pre-contractual measures requested by the data subject, and compliance with legal obligations applicable to the professional activity of ACM 2020.

sections.title: Data recipients
sections.content: Personal data will not be disclosed to third parties except where required by law. No international data transfers are made outside the European Economic Area. Should it become necessary to share data with third parties for the provision of contracted services, the data subject will be informed beforehand.

sections.title: Data subject rights
sections.content: The data subject may exercise the rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing, and data portability by sending a request to acm@acm2020.es or by post to the address indicated above. The data subject also has the right to lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es) if they consider that the processing of their data infringes current regulations.

sections.title: Data retention
sections.content: Personal data will be retained for the time necessary to fulfil the purpose for which it was collected and to determine any liabilities that may arise from that purpose and the processing of the data. The provisions contained in the applicable archiving and documentation regulations will apply.

sections.title: Security measures
sections.content: ACM 2020 has adopted the technical and organisational measures necessary to guarantee the security and integrity of personal data and to prevent its alteration, loss, unauthorised processing or access, taking into account the state of technology, the nature of the data stored, and the risks to which it is exposed.

sections.title: What are cookies?
sections.content: Cookies are small text files stored on the user's device (computer, tablet, or mobile phone) when visiting a website. They are used to remember user preferences, analyse browsing behaviour, and improve the website experience. Cookies cannot damage your device or access personal information stored on it.

sections.title: Types of cookies used
sections.content:
Technical cookies: necessary for the basic functioning of the website, such as navigating between pages and accessing secure areas. Without them, the website would not function correctly.

Preference cookies: allow the website to remember the user's choices, such as the selected language or the region from which they access the site.

Analytical cookies: collect information anonymously about how visitors use the website, which pages they visit most frequently, and whether they receive error messages. This information is used to improve website performance.

sections.title: Managing and disabling cookies
sections.content:
The user can configure their browser to reject the installation of cookies or to be notified when a website attempts to install one. Please note that disabling cookies may affect the functionality of the website.

To manage cookies from your browser, consult the instructions provided by your browser manufacturer.

sections.title: Updates to the cookie policy
sections.content: ACM 2020 reserves the right to update this Cookie Policy at any time to adapt it to legislative changes, case law developments, or sector practices. Any modifications will be published on this same page.
